## Phase 2 (Repair) complete — RED→GREEN with mutation evidence

**Commit `ce3b62144aeb35be7fc59e900fd7db0c8447bdfb`** (local only — NOT pushed, per operator
instruction). 25 files, +806/-84. Trailer verified: `verify-commit-ticket --rev ce3b62144aeb`
→ `OK - resolved 0514-92e0-e6c4-4304`.

### GREEN — against an oracle the fixer never saw

The RED test was moved OUT of the implementing subagent's working tree before it was launched;
it received only the contract card (postconditions + invariants), never the fixture, assertions,
or path. Restored and run after the fix:

    tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_status_relocated_store.py
    5 passed in 3.50s

    reads_env_id_from_a_relocated_store                          PASSED
    error_never_names_the_unconfigured_repo_root_path            PASSED
    resolves_the_last_pass_detail_file_in_a_relocated_store      PASSED
    still_works_in_the_default_in_tree_layout                    PASSED  (AC16 control)
    cli_succeeds_against_a_relocated_store                       PASSED  (E2E via real CLI)

### Mutation check — the test has teeth

Re-introduced the EXACT confirmed root cause (`path = repo_root / ".tickets-tracker" / ".env-id"`)
and re-ran. Executed inside an OS sandbox denying writes outside the worktree + a scratch dir,
per the destructive-mutation rule:

    4 failed, 1 passed

i.e. it returns to precisely the original RED shape — the four relocation tests fail, the in-tree
control still passes. Fix restored and re-verified green (21/21 including the gate self-tests).

A test that stayed green under that mutation would have been a tautology. It did not.

### Verification output (real)

    $ make lint
    ruff check src tests scripts ......................... All checks passed!
    ruff format --check src tests scripts ................ 2466 files already formatted
    check_complexity_baseline.py --check ................. active=40 new=0 increased=0 stale=9
    check_config_ownership / check_config_reads .......... OK
    gen_env_registry.py --check .......................... OK
    check_comment_hygiene / check_raw_git_writes ......... OK
    check_wall_clock_asserts ............................. clean
    check_destructive_test_exec .......................... OK
    check_tickets_boundary.py ............................ OK   <-- the new gate
    check_dco_identity / criteria_vocabulary / skill ..... OK
    check_shellcheck / zizmor ............................ No findings to report
    MAKE LINT EXIT: 0

    $ make typecheck
    mypy src/rebar scripts
    Success: no issues found in 678 source files
    MAKE TYPECHECK EXIT: 0

    $ pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler tests/interfaces/facades tests/unit/test_tickets_boundary_guard.py
    4276 passed, 2 skipped in 600.71s

`new=0 increased=0` on the complexity ratchet — no baseline edit was needed or made.
`docs/env-vars.md` was regenerated; the diff is pure line-number drift from added comments, with
no env var added or removed.

### AC17 LIVE VALIDATION — **NOT MET. Pending deployment.**

Deliberately NOT ticked. I am not pushing or deploying, so the deployed container still runs the
old code. Baseline recorded just now against `https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/mcp`:

    tool: bridge_status
    args: {}
    response: {"error": "command_failed", "exit_code": 1,
      "message": "cannot read bridge status: cannot read local environment id from
       /var/gerrit/site/mcp-code/.tickets-tracker/.env-id:
       [Errno 2] No such file or directory"}

This is the unfixed behaviour, byte-for-byte the reported symptom. It is the *before* half of
AC17's evidence. The *after* half requires the change to land AND the container to redeploy, and
must be re-observed and recorded here by whoever does that. A passing local test is explicitly
not a substitute, and neither is a merge.

### Fix-safety audit

- **Restoration, not creation.** Every hunk routes an existing path through an existing resolver.
  No new entry point, command, or user-visible artifact.
- **No new dependency.** All imports are `rebar.config` / existing siblings.
- **No test weakened.** No pre-existing test was edited. `git_adapter.TRACKER_DIR` was PRESERVED
  precisely so its characterization test keeps passing unchanged.
- **Refactoring litmus.** The oracle asserts observable behaviour (returned snapshot fields,
  error text, CLI exit code), not private names or source text, so a behaviour-preserving
  refactor cannot turn it red.

### What I did NOT do

- **Did not push or submit.** The commit is local on branch `0514-tracker-path-resolver`.
- **Did not close the ticket**, and did not tick AC17.
- **Did not migrate** pre-fix data at `<repo_root>/.tickets-tracker` (DD6 records the reasoning;
  CHANGELOG carries the operator note).
- **Did not use any force override.** None was needed; nothing was blocked.
- **`cca6-3f7e-dd67-439f` is not closed.** Its AC1-AC5 are satisfied by this commit (they are a
  subset of AC8/AC9), but closing another ticket was outside my brief.
